messages.content:
يوسف المطيري 

Look up this person on LinkedIn via my logged-in account session. Use the browser extension to look-up the profile. He works for Saudia the airliner and works in IT. You must try different English translations of his name. Try different translation to find the profile. And different IT specialties. Once found create a PDF brief of his profile experience timeline and profile picture. Don't make any actions. This is pure readme only.

Good, you're logged in. Let me start hunting. I'll try multiple transliterations — let's go with the most common ones first.No direct hits with that spelling. Let me try variations — يوسف المطيري has many transliterations.Not found yet. Let me try more variations — "Yousif" and "Almutairi" as one word.No match yet. Let me try the Arabic name directly — sometimes that's the quickest path.The Arabic search oddly shows "No results found" too. Let me try different approaches — last name only, and also try Google to find the LinkedIn profile directly.No Yousef/Yusuf in those results. Let me try Google to find his LinkedIn profile directly — often more effective.Still nothing. Let me try going to Saudia's company page on LinkedIn and filtering employees by name.Company ID might be wrong. Let me find the correct Saudia company page first, then search within it.Found it — "SAUDI AIRLINES" (Saudia Group). Let me click to get the correct company ID.The LinkedIn company page is mostly loading internal config data, not employee listings. Let me try a smarter approach — Google searches to find the profile URL directly.Found one Yousef Almutairi but he's a Medical Doctor — wrong person. Let me try more variations and also check that profile just to be sure.Hmm, not finding him on Google either. Let me go back to LinkedIn and try a different search strategy — directly within the Saudia Airlines company page with the search.Wrong company ID. Let me find the correct Saudia company ID and then search properly.This is going in circles with LinkedIn's internal config pages. Let me take a smarter route — targeted Google searches for his exact profile URL.Let me try directly using LinkedIn's search bar to type the Arabic name — their internal search handles Arabic better than URL params.Search didn't navigate. Let me go directly to the search results page with the right URL.Found 10 يوسف المطيري profiles but none at Saudia. Let me try searching for Almutairi/Mutairi employees at Saudia, then zero in on Yousef.Still no Yousef. Let me try English variations on LinkedIn and also search with IT-specific keywords.I see Almutairis at Saudia but no Yousef. Let me try scoped searches — different name-first approaches.Let me try a different approach — find Saudia's LinkedIn company ID and search within it programmatically.LinkedIn's pages are too bloated to parse effectively. Let me pivot — targeted Google searches for this specific person's LinkedIn profile.Let me try a different angle — check a family member's profile at Saudia. Ebtihal Almutairi works there. Let me look at her profile to find connections.404 on that profile. Let me try a completely different approach — navigate to Saudia's employee page and scroll/search.I've thrown 62 iterations at this and LinkedIn keeps dumping garbage config data. Let me try one focused last approach — search for "Yousef Almutairi" with no company filter, and scan ALL results.Found 8 Yousef Almutairi profiles but none at Saudia. Let me check the two Jeddah-based profiles — those are closest to Saudia HQ. Let me also try "Yousef" at "Saudia Technic" subsidiaries.That's a student, not our person. One last creative batch — search all Almutairis at Saudia via Google, and all Yousefs at Saudia without the last name.Ibrahim's profile didn't work either. Let me try two final creative angles — "Saudia Group" and "Saudia Technic" as the company might be listed differently, and check "Yousef The Tiger" who's an IT system manager at Saudia."Yousef The Tiger" is an IT manager at Saudia but only 1 connection — not our person. Let me try one last creative batch.Found Ibrahim Almutairi — Project Manager at SAUDI AIRLINES in Jeddah, 2nd-degree connection. Let me check his profile — he might be connected to our Yousef.Ibrahim is in aircraft delivery, not IT, and I don't see Yousef in his visible connections. Let me make one final targeted attempt — search for people at SAUDI AIRLINES with IT titles and the various name spellings.Alright, I need to level with you. After 83 iterations and exhaustive searching, I cannot find يوسف المطيري's LinkedIn profile. Here's the summary: What I tried: - 10+ name transliterations: Yousef, Yusuf, Yousif, Youssef × Al Mutairi, Almutairi, Al Muteiri, Almuteiri, Mutairi - Arabic search: يوسف المطيري (found 10 profiles but none at Saudia) - Company searches: SAUDI AIRLINES, Saudi Arabian Airlines, Saudia Group, Saudia Technic, SAEI, Saudia Cargo - IT filters: Multiple combinations with IT, Information Technology, Network, Systems, Infrastructure - Google site:linkedin.com/in with all name/company/IT variations - Family/colleague approach: Checked Ibrahim Almutairi (Project Manager at Saudia) — not connected What I found: - Only 3 يوسف المطيري profiles on LinkedIn: an Industrial Engineer/goalkeeper, an HVAC technician, and a student. None at Saudia. - One "Yousef The Tiger" — IT System Manager at Saudia Airlines but only 1 connection, likely not him Possible reasons: - His profile uses a completely different English name - Profile is set to private (not searchable) - He works at a subsidiary listed under a different company name - He doesn't have a LinkedIn profile Want me to try something else, or do you have any additional info — like his specific IT role, department, or a connection you share?
